resolutions.researcher_notes: Total project investment for the whole WEP2 system: 1422亿元 = 142,200,000,000 RMB (SegmentCost is carried in full currency units in this tracker; SegmentCostUnits is the bare currency code per the locked vocabulary). AGGREGATE-VS-SEGMENT CHECK: 1422亿 is the SYSTEM figure and this row IS the system, so it is at the right granularity — but it must NOT be pasted onto any WEP2 branch row. The two MEE 竣工验收 letters give the SECTION totals 538.04亿元 (西段) and 630.24亿元 (东段), which sum to 1168.28亿元; the ~254亿元 remainder is the branch/联络线 scope completed outside those two acceptance packages. SegmentCostYear left BLANK deliberately: every source states 1422亿元 as the announced total project investment (first published at the 2008-02-22 groundbreaking and repeated unchanged through 2021) and none states a price base year — filling one would be fabrication.

resolutions.researcher_notes: STAGED AT 12 MPa, BUT THE SYSTEM DOES NOT HAVE ONE UNIFORM MAINLINE PRESSURE — read the __VALIDITY__ before pasting. Whole-line evidence: 陆家嘴金融网 carrying 西部管道's own 西二线投产十周年 feature describes the line as '管材X80高钢级、管径1219毫米大口径，12兆帕高压力，年输气量300亿立方米，主要包括1条干线和8条支干线' and calls 12兆帕 '长输管道压力全球第一'; 人民网上海 2021 calls WEP2 China's '压力最高' gas pipeline without giving the number. Section evidence: MEE 环验〔2015〕227号 (西段, 霍尔果斯→靖边) '干线管径为1219毫米、设计压力12兆帕' — but MEE 环验〔2016〕100号 (东段, 麟游→广州从化) gives '干线管径1219毫米，设计压力10兆帕'. So 12 MPa is the design pressure of the WESTERN mainline and the headline figure for the system; the EASTERN mainline is 10 MPa, as are all 支干线/联络线 in both acceptance letters. Tier is medium, independent false: the two refs are not independent confirmations of one number — one is a whole-line statement, one a section document, and the second whole-line source (人民网) omits the figure. Rejected: ncsti.gov.cn's '压力10~12兆帕' line, whose surrounding block (工程为1干1支，总长度为4661千米…与西二线并行约3000千米) is internally self-contradictory and actually describes another line. Searched for a PipeChina/CNPC whole-line design-pressure statement; cnpc.com.cn returns 412 (WAF) and has no Wayback capture of its 西气东输 page.

resolutions.researcher_notes: ProposalYear 2007. 求是网 2024-10-21 ('西气东输二线于2007年启动，2011年投入运营') and China Daily 2022-01-04 ('2007年，西气东输二线工程正式启动，2011年投入运营') both state it while naming the line, but their wording is near-identical, so they are treated as ONE origin — tier medium, independent false, not high. Independent CONTEMPORANEOUS corroboration exists and is described here rather than cited, because it fails the name test: the Wayback capture of Xinhua English 2007-04-06 'CNPC plans to build longest LNG pipeline' (https://web.archive.org/web/20121008124425/http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2007-04/06/content_5942133.htm) reports the plan four months into 2007 with this project's unmistakable specs — CNPC-operated, from northwest Xinjiang to Guangzhou, gas from Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan, 'annual capacity of 30 billion cubic meters', construction 'planned to start next year' — but it calls the project only 'China's longest natural gas pipeline' and uses 'West-East pipeline' for WEP1, so it never names THIS row (proposal-stage figures of 6,500 km / 80亿元 also differ from as-built, as expected at that stage). PetroChina's 2007 annual report (March 2008) lists 西气东输二线 among the 2008 capex projects, confirming the project was a funded plan by end-2007. Downstream anchors: MEE records the EIA approval as 环审〔2008〕18号 (January 2008) for the west section and 环审〔2008〕318号 (August 2008) for the east, and construction began 2008-02 — both consistent with a 2007 proposal. ProposalMonth left BLANK: no source states a month, and the April 2007 Xinhua dateline is the earliest located public announcement, not a stated proposal date.

resolutions.researcher_notes: VALUE CHANGE STAGED — see the __VALIDITY__. The sheet carries Owner1 = 'China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd' (中石油西部管道公司) at 100%, which is wrong on two counts for a whole-system row. (1) SCOPE: 西部管道公司 only ever ran WEP2 WEST of 中卫/靖边. The NEA Henan filing (henb.nea.gov.cn upfiles/2016/1.xls) records 中石油西气东输管道公司 — a different CNPC company — as the operating enterprise of 西二线河南段 (481.97 km, 灵宝→唐河, 投产 2010-11-01), and 人民网上海 2021 says 国家管网集团西气东输公司 runs everything east of 中卫. (2) DATE: CNPC sold its trunk pipeline assets to PipeChina with effect from 2020-10-01; 界面新闻 via sina.cn (2020-04-05) lists BOTH 中石油西部管道公司 and 中国石油西气东输管道分公司 among the eight CNPC entities absorbed into 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司. The NDRC's 2023 tariff appendix, 《国家管网集团经营的跨省天然气管道表》, then lists 西气东输二线东段（中卫以东）宁夏中卫→广东广州 (row 8) and 西气东输二线西段（中卫以西）新疆霍尔果斯→宁夏中卫 (row 30) — i.e. this row's entire Khorgas→Guangzhou extent — as PipeChina pipelines. Proposed value therefore uses the entity string already in the tracker (see P4657): 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司, 100%. Tier medium rather than high: two regulator/state sources independently place the whole line under PipeChina, but no source states a percentage — 100% is the reading of an outright asset purchase (not a JV), so a reviewer should confirm before pasting. Do NOT create a new owner entity.

resolutions.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE AND SCOPE CONFIRMED; THREE THINGS FOR THE REVIEWER. Existence/identity: the row is real and correctly scoped as the whole WEP2 trunk — the NDRC's 2023 PipeChina tariff table carries it as exactly two regulated segments spanning 新疆霍尔果斯→宁夏中卫 and 宁夏中卫→广东广州, matching the sheet's Khorgas→Guangzhou extent, and the two MEE 竣工验收 letters cover the same two halves. No deletion, no reclassification, no duplication with the WEP2 branch rows (P4944 南昌-上海支干线, P4946 樟树-湘潭联络线, P4793/P5861 etc.), which are named as 支干线 OF this trunk in both the NDRC table and MEE 环验〔2016〕100号. (1) CARRIED v2 OWNER-MISATTRIBUTION CONCERN IS UPHELD AND NOW RESOLVED WITH EVIDENCE: Owner1 'China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd' is a WEST-SECTION-ONLY, PRE-2020 attribution. The NEA Henan filing shows a different CNPC company (中石油西气东输管道公司) operating the Henan (east) section, and CNPC's trunk assets moved to PipeChina effective 2020-10-01. A change to 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 [100%] is staged on the Owner and Operator units. (2) PRESSURE IS SECTION-DEPENDENT: MEE gives 12 兆帕 for the WEST mainline and 10 兆帕 for the EAST mainline (and 10 兆帕 for every 支干线/联络线). GEM's single Pressure cell cannot hold both. 12 is staged as the system's design maximum and headline figure; the alternative is to leave Pressure blank on the parent and carry 12/10 on west/east rows. Reviewer decision. (3) LENGTH IS QUOTED THREE WAYS AND THE SHEET'S 9102 km IS THE RIGHT ONE, BUT KNOW THE OTHERS: 9102 km (Xinhua 2008, 经济日报 2010, 十堰日报 2008, 人民日报 2023, 人民网 2021 — trunk plus all branches) vs 8704 km (NEA 2012-09-24, NEA 2012-11-05, 界面新闻, 陆家嘴/西部管道: '1条干线和8条支干线，干线全长4918公里') vs 8653 km (the Jiangxi DRC 2014 plan quoted in shards/P4649.json). The MEE section letters sum to 3744.67 + 4069.17 = 7813.84 km for the two acceptance packages. Length is already sourced at high in this batch and is NOT re-staged here; the spread is recorded so nobody 'corrects' 9102 to 8704. Sub-line count is likewise quoted as 8 支干线 (NEA, 界面, Xinhua) and as 3 支干线 (人民网 2021) — the latter counts only the large ones.
